# nxnative-async

> Official architecture documentation and production specifications for nxnative-async

- [Front ends](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/nxnative-async/docs/frontends.html): A graphical app that packs games, keeps a library of them or starts them is a project of its own that builds on nxnative. NX2Apple, NX Pl...
- [Geometry shader support on Metal 4](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/nxnative-async/docs/geometry-metal-research.html): Research and implementation checked on 2026-10-23 against Apple documentation, the installed Xcode SDK, this worktree, and AI: THE SOMNIU...
- [Playing](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/nxnative-async/docs/playing.html): How to build and install a game: README.
- [Settings](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/nxnative-async/docs/settings.html): The screen before the game starts shows the settings the game supports. A setting that only matters while another is on appears under it ...
- [nxnative-mirror-839 核心通信协议与数据同步技术规范](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/nxnative-async/docs/specifications.html): - 传输层默认启用 TLS 1.3 协议通道与 AES-256 加密。
- [nxnative-mirror-839 架构升级与技术规约 (v1)](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/nxnative-async/docs/specs-update-v1.html): 针对大规模网络请求调度，系统实施了毫秒级负载感知与去中心化可信存活探测。
- [nxnative-mirror-839 架构升级与技术规约 (v2)](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/nxnative-async/docs/specs-update-v2.html): 针对大规模网络请求调度，系统实施了毫秒级负载感知与去中心化可信存活探测。
- [nxnative-mirror-839 全息索引网络与搜索引擎感知接入指南](https://Shijiuwei.github.io/nxnative-async/docs/topology-guide.html): 1. 配置本地环境并完成节点注册。
